newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA RUPEE STEADY V DLR IN SPOT, WEAKENS IN FWD.
newsitem.headline: INDIA RUPEE STEADY V DLR IN SPOT, WEAKENS IN FWD.

text.p: The Indian rupee was steady in quiet early afternoon Monday trade but forward premiums edged up mildly after opening lower, dealers said.
Spot rupee was steady at 35.715/720 against the dollar.

"Premiums opened three paise lower but are back to old levels," said a dealer. The forward dollar market was active in October, January and July maturities, corresponding roughly to three months, six months and one year, dealers said.
The Reserve Bank of India was not in the market, they said.
"No one is expecting them today," a dealer said.
